kaikki_vikisozluk.e: اِسْلَنْطَحَ • (islanṭaḥa) IIIq (non-past يَسْلَنْطِحُ (yaslanṭiḥu), verbal noun اِسْلِنْطَاح (islinṭāḥ))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From the root س ل ط ح (s l ṭ ḥ); possibly related to سُلْطُح (sulṭuḥ, “slanting, rising gradually”).
s: س ل ط ح (s l ṭ ḥ)
